title: The Mechanics of Mafia
coreMove: Test culture by whether shared purpose and role fit lower friction under pressure.
sourcePressure: The chapter moves from structure to culture, arguing that intense companies need mission fit, loyalty, and close cooperation rather than generic professionalism or perks. The frozen source for this chapter contains no chapter-specific named anecdote beyond author/editor metadata, so examples should use fictional protagonists and stay anchored to verified terms.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Romanticizing startup culture as vibes, perks, or cultish intensity.
